components.name: Accessibility Button
components.title: Trigger - Accessibility Button
components.description: The trigger Accessibility Button is executed when the additional button on the navigation bar is clicked. Only devices that provide the navigation bar with software buttons support this trigger.

components.name: Active Network Type
components.title: Trigger - Active Network Type
components.description: The trigger Active Network Type executes a flow when the active network type changes to another type.

components.name: Activity Ended
components.title: Trigger - Activity Ended
components.description: The trigger Activity Ended is executed when an activity is moved to the background.

components.name: Activity Started
components.title: Trigger - Activity Started
components.description: The trigger Activity Started is executed when an activity is moved to the foreground.

components.name: Airplane Mode
components.title: Trigger - Airplane Mode
components.description: The trigger Airplane Mode is executed when the airplane mode is turned on or off.

components.name: Android Wear Device Connected/Disconnected
components.title: Trigger - Android Wear Device Connected/Disconnected
components.description: The trigger Android Wear Device is executed when an Android Wear device is connected or disconnected from the main device.

components.name: App Package Event
components.title: Trigger - App Package Event
components.description: The trigger App Package Event is executed when a app/package is installed, updated or removed.

components.name: App Task Ended
components.title: Trigger - App Task Ended
components.description: The trigger App Task Ended is executed when an application is moved to the background or closed respectively the user moved the focus to another app. The application might still be running in the background or the process hosting the application might still be in memory.

components.name: App Task Started
components.title: Trigger - App Task Started
components.description: The trigger App Task Started is executed when an application is moved to the foreground or opened respectively the user moved the focus to this app.

components.name: Assist
components.title: Trigger - Assist
components.description: The trigger Assist is executed when the home button is long-pressed or dragged upwards (Galaxy Nexus) or the home button is long-pressed and the middle icon is selected (S3).

components.name: Audio Volume
components.title: Trigger - Audio Volume
components.description: The trigger Audio Volume is executed when the volume of the device has been changed. Some devices report the volume change slightly delayed.

components.name: Auto Sync State
components.title: Trigger - Auto Sync State
components.description: The trigger Auto Sync State is executed when the auto sync setting is changed to on or off.

components.name: Automagic Notification Selected
components.title: Trigger - Automagic Notification Selected
components.description: The trigger Automagic Notification Selected executes a flow when the Automagic-wand notification available in the statusbar is selected.

components.name: Automagic Startup
components.title: Trigger - Automagic Startup
components.description: The trigger Automagic Startup is executed when the Automagic service is completely started and the flows have been loaded.

components.name: Battery Level
components.title: Trigger - Battery Level
components.description: The trigger Battery Level is executed whenever the battery level changes and the built in condition about the level holds true.

components.name: Battery Level (Android Wear)
components.title: Trigger - Battery Level (Android Wear)
components.description: The trigger Battery Level (Android Wear) is executed whenever the battery level changes and the built in condition about the level holds true.

components.name: Battery Low Condition
components.title: Trigger - Battery Low Condition
components.description: The trigger Battery Low Condition is executed when the battery level becomes low or when the battery level becomes OK again after it was low.

components.name: Bluetooth Device Connected
components.title: Trigger - Bluetooth Device Connected
components.description: The trigger Bluetooth Device Connected is executed when a bluetooth device is connected.

components.name: Bluetooth Device Disconnected
components.title: Trigger - Bluetooth Device Disconnected
components.description: The trigger Bluetooth Device Disconnected is executed when a bluetooth device is disconnected.

components.name: Bluetooth State
components.title: Trigger - Bluetooth State
components.description: The trigger Bluetooth State is executed when the bluetooth adapter of the device is turned on or off depending on the settings used.

components.name: Calendar
components.title: Trigger - Calendar
components.description: The trigger Calendar is executed on the defined date and time.

components.name: Calendar Event
components.title: Trigger - Calendar Event
components.description: The trigger Calendar Event is executed when an event on the calendar starts or ends.

components.name: Car UI Mode
components.title: Trigger - Car UI Mode
components.description: The trigger Car UI Mode is executed when the device is put into car UI mode when placed in a car dock.

components.name: Clipboard Changed
components.title: Trigger - Clipboard Changed
components.description: The trigger Clipboard Changed is executed when the content of the clipboard changes. Use the action Copy Text from Clipboard to access the content of the clipboard.

components.name: Command Output
components.title: Trigger - Command Output
components.description: The trigger Command Output is executed when a command prints a line containing a specific text.

components.name: Compass
components.title: Trigger - Compass
components.description: The trigger Compass executes the flow when the device changes its orientation.

components.name: Content Provider Changed
components.title: Trigger - Content Provider Changed
components.description: The trigger Content Provider Changed is executed whenever the content provider is changed for the specified URI. Note that not all content providers support this feature.

components.name: CyanogenMod Quick Settings Tile Selected
components.title: Trigger - CyanogenMod Quick Settings Tile Selected
components.description: The trigger CyanogenMod Quick Settings Tile Selected creates a quick settings tile and is executed when the tile is selected/clicked.

components.name: Daydream State
components.title: Trigger - Daydream State
components.description: The trigger Daydream State is executed when the daydream of the system starts or stops.

components.name: Desk UI Mode
components.title: Trigger - Desk UI Mode
components.description: The trigger Desk UI Mode is executed when the device is put into desk UI mode when placed in a desk dock.

components.name: Device Idle/Doze Mode
components.title: Trigger - Device Idle/Doze Mode
components.description: The trigger Device Idle/Doze Mode is executed when the device falls into idle/doze mode or is woken up from this mode.

components.name: Device Orientation
components.title: Trigger - Device Orientation
components.description: The trigger Device Orientation executes the flow when the device is moved to the defined orientation.

components.name: Device Storage Space Low
components.title: Trigger - Device Storage Space Low
components.description: The trigger Device Storage Space Low executes the flow when the internal device storage space becomes low or the free storage space is back to a normal level.

components.name: Display State
components.title: Trigger - Display State
components.description: The trigger Display State is executed when the display is turned on or off.

components.name: Dock Event
components.title: Trigger - Dock Event
components.description: The trigger Dock Event is executed when the device is put into a dock (car, desk, some external hardware keyboard).

components.name: File Observer
components.title: Trigger - File Observer
components.description: The trigger File Observer is executed when a path of interest on the filesystem is accessed or changed.

components.name: Fingerprint Gesture
components.title: Trigger - Fingerprint Gesture
components.description: The trigger Fingerprint Gesture executes a flow when one of the supported gestures is executed on the fingerprint sensor.

components.name: General Broadcast
components.title: Trigger - General Broadcast
components.description: The trigger General Broadcast dynamically registers a broadcast receiver at runtime with the specified intent filter. Please also see the Android Developer Documentation.

components.name: Gleeo Recording Started
components.title: Trigger - Gleeo Recording Started
components.description: The trigger Gleeo Recording Started is executed when a task in Gleeo Time Tracker has been started.

components.name: Gleeo Recording Stopped
components.title: Trigger - Gleeo Recording Stopped
components.description: The trigger Gleeo Recording Stopped is executed when a task in Gleeo Time Tracker has been stopped.

components.name: Global Variable
components.title: Trigger - Global Variable
components.description: The trigger Global Variable is executed when a different value is assigned to a global variable. The trigger is not executed when the same value is assigned to the variable again.

components.name: Global Variable Date/Time
components.title: Trigger - Global Variable Date/Time
components.description: The trigger Global Variable Date/Time is executed when the point of time stored in the global variable is reached.

components.name: Gmail Unread Conversation Count
components.title: Trigger - Gmail Unread Conversation Count
components.description: The trigger Gmail Unread Conversation Count is executed when the count of unread conversations in the Gmail app on the device changes.

components.name: GPS Status Event
components.title: Trigger - GPS Status Event
components.description: The trigger GPS Status Event is executed, when the system start or stops to use GPS.

components.name: Hardware Keyboard State
components.title: Trigger - Hardware Keyboard State
components.description: The trigger Hardware Keyboard State is executed when the hardware keyboard is opened or closed.

components.name: Hardware Keyboard Type
components.title: Trigger - Hardware Keyboard Type
components.description: The trigger Hardware Keyboard Type is executed when the type of hardware keyboard changes to one of the selected types.

components.name: HTTP Request (Experimental)
components.title: Trigger - HTTP Request (Experimental)
components.description: The trigger HTTP Request (Experimental) is executed when a HTTP request is received using the specified path and port.

components.name: Incoming Call
components.title: Trigger - Incoming Call
components.description: The trigger Incoming Call is executed when a call is received depending on the criteria defined in the options.

components.name: Interruptions Mode
components.title: Trigger - Interruptions Mode
components.description: The trigger Interruptions Mode is executed when the device switches to the desired interruption mode.

components.name: K-9 Mail Received
components.title: Trigger - K-9 Mail Received
components.description: The trigger K-9 Mail Received is executed when K-9 Mail receives a mail.

components.name: Hardware Key Event
components.title: Trigger - Hardware Key Event
components.description: The trigger Hardware Key Event is executed when the specified key is pressed/released. Most devices usually only provide hardware keys for volume up and volume down. The power key can usually not be intercepted.

components.name: Launch Browser App Intent Received
components.title: Trigger - Launch Browser App Intent Received
components.description: The trigger Launch Browser App Intent Received is executed when an app or the system wants to launch a browser app.

components.name: Launch Calculator App Intent Received
components.title: Trigger - Launch Calculator App Intent Received
components.description: The trigger Launch Calculator App Intent Received is executed when an app or the system wants to launch a calculator app.

components.name: Launch Calendar App Intent Received
components.title: Trigger - Launch Calendar App Intent Received
components.description: The trigger Launch Calendar App Intent Received is executed when an app or the system wants to launch a calendar app.

components.name: Launch Contacts App Intent Received
components.title: Trigger - Launch Contacts App Intent Received
components.description: The trigger Launch Contacts App Intent Received is executed when an app or the system wants to launch a contacts/address book app.

components.name: Launch Mail App Intent Received
components.title: Trigger - Launch Mail App Intent Received
components.description: The trigger Launch Mail App Intent Received is executed when an app or the system wants to launch a browser app.

components.name: Launch Music App Intent Received
components.title: Trigger - Launch Music App Intent Received
components.description: The trigger Launch Music App Intent Received is executed when an app or the system wants to launch a music app.

components.name: Launcher Trigger
components.title: Trigger - Launcher Trigger
components.description: The trigger Launcher Trigger is executed when the launcher entry with the name Launcher Trigger is manually started or when another app launches the entry.

components.name: Light Sensor
components.title: Trigger - Light Sensor
components.description: The trigger Light Sensor is executed when the measured surrounding light intensity passes the defined value.

components.name: Locale Adjusted
components.title: Trigger - Locale Adjusted
components.description: The trigger Locale Adjusted is executed when the locale has been changed in the system.

components.name: Location
components.title: Trigger - Location
components.description: The trigger Location is executed when the location is entering the defined region or exiting the defined region. The accuracy of the location depends heavily on the available location provider.

components.name: Location Provider State
components.title: Trigger - Location Provider State
components.description: The trigger Location Provider State is executed when a location provider (GPS or Network) is enabled or disabled.

components.name: Login Attempt
components.title: Trigger - Login Attempt
components.description: The trigger Login Attempt is executed, whenever someone unsuccessfully tries to login to the device respectively tries to unlock the device.

components.name: Magnetic Field Sensor
components.title: Trigger - Magnetic Field Sensor
components.description: The trigger Magnetic Field Sensor is executed when the measured magnetic field strength passes the defined value.

components.name: Media Button Event (Experimental)
components.title: Trigger - Media Button Event (Experimental)
components.description: The trigger Media Button Event (Experimental) executes a flow when the system detects a media button event, for example when the play-button is pressed on a headset.

components.name: Media Session Changed (Experimental)
components.title: Trigger - Media Session Changed (Experimental)
components.description: The trigger Media Session Changed (Experimental) is executed when the media session of the specified player changes (new track is played, media image is loaded etc.). A regular change in position alone does not invoke the trigger.

components.name: Mobile Datanetwork Type
components.title: Trigger - Mobile Datanetwork Type
components.description: The trigger Mobile Datanetwork Type is executed when the network type switches to one selected in the list.

components.name: Next Alarm
components.title: Trigger - Next Alarm
components.description: The trigger Next Alarm is executed when the next alarm set in the Android alarm app is reached.

components.name: NFC State
components.title: Trigger - NFC State
components.description: The trigger NFC State is executed when the NFC adapter of the device is turned on or off depending on the settings used.

components.name: NFC Tag
components.title: Trigger - NFC Tag
components.description: The trigger NFC Tag executes the flow when an NFC tag is detected. You can either write a special ID to the NFC tag that will be used to identify the tag and execute the flow (this is the recommended option to use when you have a writable NFC tag) or you can also read the ID of an existing NFC tag. This is especially useful for read-only NFC tags like the ones often found in credit cards or read-only NFC tags (Live Tags, Smart Tags etc.) of some device manufacturers. Please also check the Tip in the settings section of this page.

components.name: Notification on Screen Displayed
components.title: Trigger - Notification on Screen Displayed
components.description: The trigger Notification on Screen Displayed is executed when a notification is displayed on the screen.

components.name: Notification on Statusbar Displayed
components.title: Trigger - Notification on Statusbar Displayed
components.description: The trigger Notification on Statusbar Displayed is executed when a notification is displayed in the statusbar.

components.name: Notification on Statusbar Removed
components.title: Trigger - Notification on Statusbar Removed
components.description: The trigger Notification on Statusbar Removed is executed when a notification is removed from the statusbar.

components.name: Notification on Statusbar Selected
components.title: Trigger - Notification on Statusbar Selected
components.description: The trigger Notification on Statusbar Selected executes the flow when a notification is selected that was previously shown using action Notification on Statusbar.

components.name: Outgoing Call
components.title: Trigger - Outgoing Call
components.description: The trigger Outgoing Call is executed when an outgoing call is made and the criteria defined in the options match.

components.name: Periodic Location Update
components.title: Trigger - Periodic Location Update
components.description: The trigger Periodic Location Update is executed in periodic intervals and delivers a location to the executed flow. The accuracy of the location heavily depends on the selected location provider.

components.name: Periodic Timer
components.title: Trigger - Periodic Timer
components.description: The trigger Periodic Timer is executed in the specified interval.

components.name: Periodic Timer Inexact
components.title: Trigger - Periodic Timer Inexact
components.description: The trigger Periodic Timer Inexact is executed approximately in the specified interval. The device can adjust the time of the trigger a bit and call the trigger when the device is currently also executing other tasks. This trigger uses less battery than the regular trigger Periodic Timer

components.name: User Activity (Experimental)
components.title: Trigger - User Activity (Experimental)
components.description: The trigger User Activity (Experimental) asks the device to periodically check most probably physical activity of the user like driving a car, riding a bike or walking.

components.name: Phone Cell CDMA
components.title: Trigger - Phone Cell CDMA
components.description: The trigger Phone Cell CDMA is executed when the device connects or disconnects from the defined cells. Changes within the defined list of cells don't invoke the trigger.

components.name: Phone Cell GSM
components.title: Trigger - Phone Cell GSM
components.description: The trigger Phone Cell GSM is executed when the device connects or disconnects from the defined cells. Changes within the defined list of cells don't invoke the trigger.

components.name: Phone Service State
components.title: Trigger - Phone Service State
components.description: The trigger Phone Service State is executed when the device detects the specified state.

components.name: Phone Signal Strength
components.title: Trigger - Phone Signal Strength
components.description: The trigger Phone Signal Strength is executed when the signal strength falls under or raises over the specified value.

components.name: Plugin (Experimental)
components.title: Trigger - Plugin (Experimental)
components.description: The trigger Plugin (Experimental) executes a flow when the condition of a plugin changes to true and/or false. Warning: This function is experimental and might not work with all existing plugins available in Google Play. We can not provide support for plugins.

components.name: Plugin Event (Experimental)
components.title: Trigger - Plugin Event (Experimental)
components.description: The trigger Plugin Event (Experimental) executes a flow when an event-plugin indicates an event. Warning: This function is experimental and might not work with all existing plugins available in Google Play. We can not provide support for plugins.

components.name: Power Source
components.title: Trigger - Power Source
components.description: The trigger Power Source is executed when a power source is connected to the device (charger or USB cable).

components.name: Power Source (Android Wear)
components.title: Trigger - Power Source (Android Wear)
components.description: The trigger Power Source (Android Wear) is executed when a power source is connected to the device (charger or USB cable).

components.name: Battery Saver Mode
components.title: Trigger - Battery Saver Mode
components.description: The trigger Battery Saver Mode is executed when the battery saving mode of the device is changed (Android 5+). Warning: This function does not work for manufacturer specific battery saving modes like Samsungs (Ultra-)energy saving mode or Sony and HTC specific modes. Please use action System Setting Changed on such devices.

components.name: Pressure Sensor
components.title: Trigger - Pressure Sensor
components.description: The trigger Pressure Sensor is executed when the measured pressure of the pressure sensor rises above or declines below a certain level or when the pressure changes at least the specified amount in the given time.

components.name: Proximity Sensor
components.title: Trigger - Proximity Sensor
components.description: The trigger Proximity Sensor is executed when the measured distance of the proximity sensor passes the defined distance.

components.name: Quick Settings Tile Selected
components.title: Trigger - Quick Settings Tile Selected
components.description: The trigger Quick Settings Tile Selected configures the selected quick settings tile and is executed when the tile is selected/clicked.

components.name: Ringer Mode
components.title: Trigger - Ringer Mode
components.description: The trigger Ringer Mode is executed when the device switches to the specified ringer mode.

components.name: Screen Orientation
components.title: Trigger - Screen Orientation
components.description: The trigger Screen Orientation is executed when the orientation of the device changes to portrait or landscape.

components.name: Send/Share Intent Received
components.title: Trigger - Send/Share Intent Received
components.description: The trigger Send/Share Intent Received is executed when the send/share menu is used in an app and the data is shared with Automagic.

components.name: Send/Share Multiple Intent Received
components.title: Trigger - Send/Share Multiple Intent Received
components.description: The trigger Send/Share Multiple Intent Received is executed when the send/share menu is used in an app and multiple items are shared with Automagic.

components.name: Shake
components.title: Trigger - Shake
components.description: The trigger Shake is executed when the device is shaken.

components.name: Shortcut
components.title: Trigger - Shortcut
components.description: The trigger Shortcut is executed when a shortcut on the launcher is pressed. You can create the shortcut and select an icon by pressing the Install Shortcut button.

components.name: Shortcut (Android Wear)
components.title: Trigger - Shortcut (Android Wear)
components.description: The trigger Shortcut (Android Wear) is executed when a shortcut in the list of Shortcut is selected (see Start -> Shortcut).

components.name: Shutdown
components.title: Trigger - Shutdown
components.description: The trigger Shutdown is executed before the device shutdown. A flow is executed on a best effort basis, Automagic might not have enough time to execute the flow completely or some services or interfaces might already be unavailable when the shutdown is detected.

components.name: Significant Motion Detected
components.title: Trigger - Significant Motion Detected
components.description: The trigger Significant Motion Detected is executed when the special hardware sensor of the device detects a significant motion. Automagic can not configure how strong or how long the duration of the motion needs to be to activate the sensor.

components.name: SIM State
components.title: Trigger - SIM State
components.description: The trigger SIM State is executed when the SIM state changes to one of the selected states.

components.name: Automagic SMS Delivery Report Received
components.title: Trigger - Automagic SMS Delivery Report Received
components.description: The trigger Automagic SMS Delivery Report Received is executed when an asynchronous delivery report was received.

components.name: SMS Received
components.title: Trigger - SMS Received
components.description: The trigger SMS Received is executed when an SMS is received depending on the criteria defined in the options.

components.name: SMS Sent
components.title: Trigger - SMS Sent
components.description: The trigger SMS Sent is executed when an SMS is sent and stored as a sent SMS in the default SMS outbox of the standard Android SMS database.

components.name: Sound Level (Experimental)
components.title: Trigger - Sound Level (Experimental)
components.description: The trigger Sound Level (Experimental) is executed when the recorded sound level in the environment exceed a certain level.

components.name: Speech Web Search Requested
components.title: Trigger - Speech Web Search Requested
components.description: The trigger Speech Web Search Requested is executed when the speech recognition based search is initiated, for example by long-pressing the headset hook button.

components.name: Speed
components.title: Trigger - Speed
components.description: The trigger Speed is executed when the measured speed of the GPS receiver rises above or declines below a certain level.

components.name: Step counter
components.title: Trigger - Step counter
components.description: The trigger Step counter uses the Step counter/Pedometer of the device and executes a flow when the specified number of steps have been counted. The device can optimise the battery usage and inform Automagic less often when the display is turned off.

components.name: Storage Media Event
components.title: Trigger - Storage Media Event
components.description: The trigger Storage Media Event is executed when the system mounts or unmounts the SD card or makes other changes involving the storage media.

components.name: System Setting Changed
components.title: Trigger - System Setting Changed
components.description: The trigger System Setting Changed is executed whenever a setting in the systems setting database was changed.

components.name: System Setting Changed (Android Wear)
components.title: Trigger - System Setting Changed (Android Wear)
components.description: The trigger System Setting Changed (Android Wear) is executed whenever a setting in the systems setting database was changed.

components.name: Take Note (Android Wear)
components.title: Trigger - Take Note (Android Wear)
components.description: The trigger Take Note (Android Wear) is executed when a note is taken from the Wear device.

components.name: Theater Mode (Android Wear)
components.title: Trigger - Theater Mode (Android Wear)
components.description: The trigger Theater Mode (Android Wear) is executed when the theater mode is turned on or off.

components.name: Time
components.title: Trigger - Time
components.description: The trigger Time executes the flow regularly on the specified weekday and time.

components.name: Time Adjusted
components.title: Trigger - Time Adjusted
components.description: The trigger Time Adjusted is executed when the time of the system is changed.

components.name: Timezone Adjusted
components.title: Trigger - Timezone Adjusted
components.description: The trigger Timezone Adjusted is executed when the timezone of the system has been changed.

components.name: UI Event
components.title: Trigger - UI Event
components.description: The trigger UI Event executes a flow when the system detects a change in the user interface, for example when a window is opened, a button is pressed, a list is scrolled, text has been entered etc.

components.name: User Present
components.title: Trigger - User Present
components.description: The trigger User Present executes the flow when the user activates the device and passed the unlock screen.

components.name: View Web URL Intent Received
components.title: Trigger - View Web URL Intent Received
components.description: The trigger View Web URL Intent Received is executed when an app wants to show a URL in a browser.

components.name: Voice Command Requested
components.title: Trigger - Voice Command Requested
components.description: The trigger Voice Command Requested is executed when the voice recognition by a bluetooth headset (or some other means) is requested.

components.name: Volume Long Press Event
components.title: Trigger - Volume Long Press Event
components.description: The trigger Volume Long Press Event is executed when one of the volume keys is pressed down for a longer duration or hold and then released.

components.name: WiFi Connected
components.title: Trigger - WiFi Connected
components.description: The trigger WiFi Connected is executed when a connection with the defined network has been established.

components.name: WiFi Disconnected
components.title: Trigger - WiFi Disconnected
components.description: The trigger WiFi Disconnected is executed when a connection with the defined network has been separated.

components.name: WiFi Scan Results Available
components.title: Trigger - WiFi Scan Results Available
components.description: The trigger WiFi Scan Results Available is executed when the results of a WiFi access point scan are available.

components.name: WiFi State
components.title: Trigger - WiFi State
components.description: The trigger WiFi State is executed when the devices wireless network adapter changes to one of the defined states.

components.name: WiFi Tethering State
components.title: Trigger - WiFi Tethering State
components.description: The trigger WiFi Tethering State is executed when the devices wireless network tethering setting changes to one of the defined states.

components.name: Wired Headset Plugged
components.title: Trigger - Wired Headset Plugged
components.description: The trigger Wired Headset Plugged is executed when a wired headset or earphones have been connected or disconnected.

components.name: Action Sound Playing
components.title: Condition - Action Sound Playing
components.description: The condition Action Sound Playing checks if an action Sound is currently playing a sound.

components.name: Active Cyanogen/LineageOS Profile
components.title: Condition - Active Cyanogen/LineageOS Profile
components.description: The condition Active Cyanogen/LineageOS Profile checks whether one of the listed profiles is active.

components.name: Active Network Type
components.title: Condition - Active Network Type
components.description: The condition Active Network Type checks if a network (usually WiFi or Mobile) is active and usable for data traffic.

components.name: Airplane Mode On
components.title: Condition - Airplane Mode On
components.description: The condition Airplane Mode On checks whether the airplane mode is on or not.

components.name: Android Wear Device Connected
components.title: Condition - Android Wear Device Connected
components.description: The condition Android Wear Device Connected checks whether a particular Android Wear device is currently connected to the main device.

components.name: App Process Running
components.title: Condition - App Process Running
components.description: The condition App Process Running checks whether the process hosting an app is currently running.

components.name: App Task Running
components.title: Condition - App Task Running
components.description: The condition App Task Running checks whether a task for one of the specified packages is currently running.

components.name: Audio Manager Mode
components.title: Condition - Audio Manager Mode
components.description: The condition Audio Manager Mode checks whether the device is currently configured to use the desired audio manager mode.

components.name: Audio Stream Active
components.title: Condition - Audio Stream Active
components.description: The condition Audio Stream Active checks if the defined audio stream is currently in active use.

components.name: Audio Volume
components.title: Condition - Audio Volume
components.description: The condition Audio Volume checks whether the volume of the selected stream type is above or below a certain level.

components.name: Auto-rotate Screen Enabled
components.title: Condition - Auto-rotate Screen Enabled
components.description: The condition Auto-rotate Screen Enabled checks whether the system setting to automatically rotate the screen is enabled or not.

components.name: Auto Sync Enabled
components.title: Condition - Auto Sync Enabled
components.description: The condition Auto Sync Enabled checks whether the automatic synchronisation is turned on or off either globally (the master switch) or for a specific account/authority.

components.name: Battery Level
components.title: Condition - Battery Level
components.description: The condition Battery Level checks whether the battery level is above or below a certain level.

components.name: Battery Level BLE (Experimental)
components.title: Condition - Battery Level BLE (Experimental)
components.description: The condition Battery Level BLE (Experimental) checks the battery level of a Bluetooth LE device that supports the standardized Battery service.

components.name: Battery Level (Android Wear)
components.title: Condition - Battery Level (Android Wear)
components.description: The condition Battery Level (Android Wear) checks whether the battery level is above or below a certain level.

components.name: Biometric Authentication Dialog
components.title: Condition - Biometric Authentication Dialog
components.description: The condition Biometric Authentication Dialog shows the authentication dialog of the system and validates a biometric attribute like a fingerprint.

components.name: Bluetooth Device Connected
components.title: Condition - Bluetooth Device Connected
components.description: The condition Bluetooth Device Connected checks whether a connection to a Bluetooth device exists.

components.name: Bluetooth Enabled
components.title: Condition - Bluetooth Enabled
components.description: The condition Bluetooth Enabled checks whether bluetooth is turned on or off.

components.name: Bluetooth LE Device Available
components.title: Condition - Bluetooth LE Device Available
components.description: The condition Bluetooth LE Device Available executes a BT LE scan to test if a device is currently available.

components.name: Bluetooth SCO On
components.title: Condition - Bluetooth SCO On
components.description: The condition Bluetooth SCO On checks whether communications use Bluetooth SCO or not.

components.name: Calendar Event
components.title: Condition - Calendar Event
components.description: The condition Calendar Event checks, whether an event on the calendar is currently active.

components.name: Call State
components.title: Condition - Call State
components.description: The condition Call State checks whether a call is currently active or not.

components.name: Confirmation Dialog
components.title: Condition - Confirmation Dialog
components.description: The condition Confirmation Dialog shows a dialog with a question and continues flow execution depending on the button pressed.

components.name: Custom Widget Overlay Showing
components.title: Condition - Custom Widget Overlay Showing
components.description: The condition Custom Widget Overlay Showing checks if a particular custom widget is currently showing as an overlay.

components.name: Debug Dialog

components.description: The condition Debug Dialog shows a dialog containing all variables and the corresponding values in a dialog. Buttons can be used to control if the condition continues at true or false.

components.name: Device Idle/Doze Mode Active
components.title: Condition - Device Idle/Doze Mode Active
components.description: The condition Device Idle/Doze Mode Active checks if the device is currently in idle/doze mode.

components.name: Device Orientation

components.description: The condition Device Orientation checks whether the device is in one of the specified orientation.

components.name: Device Storage Space
components.title: Condition - Device Storage Space
components.description: The condition Device Storage Space checks the storage space on the filesystem containing the specified path.

components.name: Device Storage Space Low
components.title: Condition - Device Storage Space Low
components.description: The condition Device Storage Space Low checks whether the free space of the internal memory of the device is low.

components.name: Dock State

components.name: Execution Count

components.name: Expression
components.title: Condition - Expression

components.name: Flashlight On
components.title: Condition - Flashlight On
components.description: The condition Flashlight On checks if the flashlight has been turned on by Automagic.

components.name: Flow Enabled
components.title: Condition - Flow Enabled
components.description: The condition Flow Enabled checks whether a flow is enabled or disabled.

components.name: Flow Executing

components.description: The condition Flow Executing checks if a particular flow is currently executing.

components.name: Gleeo is Recording
components.title: Condition - Gleeo is Recording
components.description: The condition Gleeo is Recording checks whether Gleeo Time Tracker is currently recording a specific project or task.

components.name: Gmail Unread Conversation Count
components.title: Condition - Gmail Unread Conversation Count
components.description: The condition Gmail Unread Conversation Count checks the number of unread conversations available in the Gmail app on the device.

components.name: Hardware Keyboard State
components.title: Condition - Hardware Keyboard State
components.description: The condition Hardware Keyboard State checks whether the hardware keyboard of the device is currently open or closed.

components.name: Hardware Keyboard Type
components.title: Condition - Hardware Keyboard Type
components.description: The condition Hardware Keyboard Type checks if the currently connected hardware keyboard type matches one of the selected types.

components.name: Host Reachable
components.title: Condition - Host Reachable
components.description: The condition Host Reachable tests whether a host can be reached by either opening a TCP-connection using a socket or by executing a ping command.

components.name: Interruptions Mode
components.title: Condition - Interruptions Mode
components.description: The condition Interruptions Mode checks if the device is in the specified interruption mode.

components.name: Keyguard Locked
components.title: Condition - Keyguard Locked
components.description: The condition Keyguard Locked checks whether or not the keyguard is currently active/showing.

components.name: Keyguard with Security
components.title: Condition - Keyguard with Security
components.description: The condition Keyguard with Security checks whether a keyguard/lockscreen with a security element (PIN, password, ...) or not (None, Swipe) is set.

components.name: Light Sensor
components.title: Condition - Light Sensor
components.description: The condition Light Sensor checks whether the measured value of the light sensor is below or above the defined level.

components.name: Location
components.title: Condition - Location
components.description: The condition Location checks whether a location is inside a specific area or not. The condition can also check if an area is entered or exited by comparing the location of the last execution and the current location.

components.name: Location Entering
components.title: Condition - Location Entering
components.description: The condition Location Entering checks whether an area has been entered or exited. This condition should only be used in conjunction with a Location trigger.

components.name: Location Provider Enabled
components.title: Condition - Location Provider Enabled
components.description: The condition Location Provider Enabled checks whether a particular location provider like GPS is enabled or not.

components.name: Magnetic Field Sensor
components.title: Condition - Magnetic Field Sensor
components.description: The condition Magnetic Field Sensor checks whether the measured value of the magnetic field sensor is below or above the defined level.

components.name: Microphone Mute
components.title: Condition - Microphone Mute
components.description: The condition Microphone Mute checks whether the microphone is currently muted.

components.name: Mobile Datanetwork Enabled
components.title: Condition - Mobile Datanetwork Enabled
components.description: The condition Mobile Datanetwork Enabled checks whether the mobile datanetwork is turned on or off.

components.name: Mobile Datanetwork Type
components.title: Condition - Mobile Datanetwork Type
components.description: The condition Mobile Datanetwork Type checks if the current datanetwork type matches one selected in the list.

components.name: Music Active
components.title: Condition - Music Active
components.description: The condition Music Active checks whether the music audio stream is currently in use.

components.name: Network Connected
components.title: Condition - Network Connected
components.description: The condition Network Connected checks if a network connection is currently available.

components.name: NFC Enabled
components.title: Condition - NFC Enabled
components.description: The condition NFC Enabled checks whether NFC is turned on or off.

components.name: Night Mode
components.title: Condition - Night Mode
components.description: The condition Night Mode checks whether the device is currently configured to use the desired night mode.

components.name: Notification on Statusbar Displayed
components.title: Condition - Notification on Statusbar Displayed
components.description: The condition Notification on Statusbar Displayed checks whether a notification of an app is displayed in the statusbar and supplies the information of the first matching notification as variables to the flow.

components.name: Phone Cell CDMA
components.title: Condition - Phone Cell CDMA
components.description: The condition Phone Cell CDMA checks whether the phone is connected to one of the specified cells of interest.

components.name: Phone Cell GSM
components.title: Condition - Phone Cell GSM
components.description: The condition Phone Cell GSM checks whether the phone is connected to one of the specified cells of interest.

components.name: Phone Service State
components.title: Condition - Phone Service State
components.description: The condition Phone Service State checks whether the phone service is currently available, unavailable or only emergency calls can be placed.

components.name: Phone Signal Strength
components.title: Condition - Phone Signal Strength
components.description: The condition Phone Signal Strength checks whether the signal strength of the mobile network is above or below a certain level.

components.name: Plugin (Experimental)
components.title: Condition - Plugin (Experimental)
components.description: The condition Plugin (Experimental) checks the condition of a plugin.

components.name: Power Source Connected
components.title: Condition - Power Source Connected
components.description: The condition Power Source Connected checks whether the device is currently connected to a power source.

components.name: Power Source Connected (Android Wear)
components.title: Condition - Power Source Connected (Android Wear)
components.description: The condition Power Source Connected (Android Wear) checks whether the device is currently connected to a power source.

components.name: Battery Saver Mode Enabled
components.title: Condition - Battery Saver Mode Enabled
components.description: The condition Battery Saver Mode Enabled checks whether the battery saver mode is active or not (Android 5+). Warning: This function does not work for manufacturer specific battery saving modes like Samsungs (Ultra-)energy saving mode or Sony and HTC specific modes. Please use action Init Variable System Setting on such devices.

components.name: Pressure Sensor
components.title: Condition - Pressure Sensor
components.description: The condition Pressure Sensor checks whether the measured pressure is below or above the defined value.

components.name: Proximity Sensor
components.title: Condition - Proximity Sensor
components.description: The condition Proximity Sensor checks whether the measured distance of the proximity sensor is below or above the defined distance.

components.name: Ringer Mode
components.title: Condition - Ringer Mode
components.description: The condition Ringer Mode checks whether the device is currently configured to use the desired ringer mode.

components.name: Roaming
components.title: Condition - Roaming
components.description: The condition Roaming checks whether you are currently in a roaming location.

components.name: Root Setting Enabled
components.title: Condition - Root Setting Enabled
components.description: The condition Root Setting Enabled checks whether the Root setting in Automagic is enabled or not.

components.name: Screen Automatic Brightness Enabled
components.title: Condition - Screen Automatic Brightness Enabled
components.description: The condition Screen Automatic Brightness Enabled checks whether the setting to change the display brightness automatically depending on the environment is turned on or not.

components.name: Screen On
components.title: Condition - Screen On
components.description: The condition Screen On checks whether the screen is currently turned on.

components.name: Screen Orientation
components.title: Condition - Screen Orientation
components.description: The condition Screen Orientation tests whether the device is currently in portrait or landscape mode.

components.name: Service Running
components.title: Condition - Service Running
components.description: The condition Service Running checks whether the specified service is currently running.

components.name: Sound Level (Experimental)
components.title: Condition - Sound Level (Experimental)
components.description: The condition Sound Level (Experimental) checks whether or not the environment sound exceed a certain level.

components.name: Speakerphone On
components.title: Condition - Speakerphone On
components.description: The condition Speakerphone On checks whether speakerphone is turned on or off.

components.name: Telephony Radio Enabled
components.title: Condition - Telephony Radio Enabled
components.description: The condition Telephony Radio Enabled checks if the radio of the phone is enabled or not.

components.name: Theater Mode On (Android Wear)
components.title: Condition - Theater Mode On (Android Wear)
components.description: The condition Theater Mode On (Android Wear) checks whether the theater mode is turned on or not.

components.name: Time Range
components.title: Condition - Time Range
components.description: The condition Time Range is true when the current time is in the defined time range.

components.name: UI Mode
components.title: Condition - UI Mode
components.description: The condition UI Mode checks whether the device is currently in car, desk, TV or normal UI mode.

components.name: USB Tethering Enabled
components.title: Condition - USB Tethering Enabled
components.description: The condition USB Tethering Enabled checks whether USB tethering is enabled or not.

components.name: Vibrate on Ring Enabled
components.title: Condition - Vibrate on Ring Enabled
components.description: The condition Vibrate on Ring Enabled checks whether the setting to vibrate on ring is enabled or not.

components.name: WiFi Access Point Enabled
components.title: Condition - WiFi Access Point Enabled
components.description: The condition WiFi Access Point Enabled checks whether a WiFi configuration is enabled and the system is allowed to connect to this access point.

components.name: WiFi Available
components.title: Condition - WiFi Available
components.description: The condition WiFi Available checks whether one specific WiFi access point is currently available. The condition waits for the first available scan result when wifi has just been enabled and no scan result is available yet.

components.name: WiFi Connected
components.title: Condition - WiFi Connected
components.description: The condition WiFi Connected checks whether the device is currently connected to one of the specified WiFi networks.

components.name: WiFi Signal Level
components.title: Condition - WiFi Signal Level
components.description: The condition WiFi Signal Level checks the signal level of the connected wifi network.

components.name: WiFi State
components.title: Condition - WiFi State
components.description: The condition WiFi State checks whether the device wireless network adapter is in the specified state.

components.name: WiFi Tethering State
components.title: Condition - WiFi Tethering State
components.description: The condition WiFi Tethering State checks whether the device wireless network adapter is in the specified state.

components.name: Wired Headset Plugged
components.title: Condition - Wired Headset Plugged
components.description: The condition Wired Headset Plugged checks whether a wired headset is currently plugged in or not.

components.name: Add WiFi Access Point
components.title: Action - Add WiFi Access Point
components.description: The action Add WiFi Access Point adds a new WiFi configuration and optionally connects to the new WiFi network.

components.name: Answer Ringing Call
components.title: Action - Answer Ringing Call
components.description: The action Answer Ringing Call answers the currently-ringing call.

components.name: Call Number
components.title: Action - Call Number
components.description: The action Call Number calls a number by opening the telephone application and directly calling the supplied number.

components.name: Clear Automagic Log
components.title: Action - Clear Automagic Log
components.description: The action Clear Automagic Log clears the internal log of Automagic (not the log on the SD-card when enabled in the preferences).

components.name: Close System Dialogs
components.title: Action - Close System Dialogs
components.description: The action Close System Dialogs closes system dialogs like the expanded notification area, the expanded quick settings or the power-menu. Whether dialog is classified as a system dialog or not is controlled by the dialog itself. Regular dialogs and windows can not be closed using this action.

components.name: Combine Images
components.title: Action - Combine Images
components.description: The action Combine Images allows to superimpose two images on top of each other. The images have to be loaded with action Init Variable Image File.

components.name: Compare Images
components.title: Action - Compare Images
components.description: The action Compare Images compares two images pixel by pixel and provides an output image that shows the differences in the selected color and provides variables containing the total number of equal and different pixels.

components.name: Connect/Disconnect Bluetooth Device
components.title: Action - Connect/Disconnect Bluetooth Device
components.description: The action Connect/Disconnect Bluetooth Device tries to connect/disconnect to/from a paired bluetooth device (Android 3+ required).

components.name: Control Audio Player
components.title: Action - Control Audio Player
components.description: The action Control Audio Player can launch and control the default audio player of Android. Note that device and manufacturer specific audio players will probably not work.

components.name: Control UI
components.title: Action - Control UI
components.description: The action Control UI uses the accessibility features of the device to control the user interface and allows to automatically press buttons, long-click elements, scroll lists and change the values of checkboxes and radio buttons.

components.name: Copy File
components.title: Action - Copy File
components.description: The action Copy File locally copies a file.

components.name: Copy Files
components.title: Action - Copy Files
components.description: The action Copy Files locally copies one or a list of files to the specified target directory or file.

components.name: Copy Text from Clipboard
components.title: Action - Copy Text from Clipboard
components.description: The action Copy Text from Clipboard copies the text on the clipboard to the specified variable.

components.name: Copy Text to Clipboard
components.title: Action - Copy Text to Clipboard
components.description: The action Copy Text to Clipboard copies the specified text to the clipboard.

components.name: Create Calendar Event
components.title: Action - Create Calendar Event
components.description: The action Create Calendar Event creates an event on the specified calendar of the device (Android 4+ required)

components.name: Create Directories
components.title: Action - Create Directories
components.description: The action Create Directories locally creates one or multiple directories.

components.name: Delete App Cache
components.title: Action - Delete App Cache
components.description: The action Delete App Cache deletes the cache files of the specified app. Android ignores this function for system apps.

components.name: Delete Files
components.title: Action - Delete Files
components.description: The action Delete Files locally deletes one or multiple files or folders including contained files.

components.name: Delete Flows
components.title: Action - Delete Flows
components.description: The action Delete Flows deletes the specified flows.

components.name: Delete HTTP Request Cookies
components.title: Action - Delete HTTP Request Cookies
components.description: The action Delete HTTP Request Cookies deletes the cookies of the desired domains that are stored by Automagic when executing action HTTP Request.

components.name: Dismiss Slide to Unlock Keyguard
components.title: Action - Dismiss Slide to Unlock Keyguard
components.description: The action Dismiss Slide to Unlock Keyguard unlocks the device when the slid-to-unlock keyguard is used. This action can not unlock a secure keyguard that requires to enter a password, PIN or pattern.

components.name: Download URL
components.title: Action - Download URL
components.description: The action Download URL directly downloads a file in the background to the defined directory.

components.name: Dropbox Create Directories
components.title: Action - Dropbox Create Directories
components.description: The action Dropbox Create Directories creates one or multiple directories on Dropbox.

components.name: Dropbox Delete Files
components.title: Action - Dropbox Delete Files
components.description: The action Dropbox Delete Files deletes the defined files on Dropbox.

components.name: Dropbox Download Files
components.title: Action - Dropbox Download Files
components.description: The action Dropbox Download Files downloads multiple files and directories recursively to your device.

components.name: Dropbox Init Variable File List
components.title: Action - Dropbox Init Variable File List
components.description: The action Dropbox Init Variable File List lists the files of a directory that match the specified name pattern.

components.name: Dropbox Upload File
components.title: Action - Dropbox Upload File
components.description: The action Dropbox Upload File uploads one file to your Dropbox.

components.name: Dropbox Upload Files
components.title: Action - Dropbox Upload Files
components.description: The action Dropbox Upload Files uploads one or multiple files and directories recursively to your Dropbox.

components.name: Enable WiFi Access Point
components.title: Action - Enable WiFi Access Point
components.description: The action Enable WiFi Access Point enables one of the access point configurations and optionally prevents to connect to other access points by disabling them.

components.name: End Call
components.title: Action - End Call
components.description: The action End Call hangs up the current call.

components.name: Execute Command
components.title: Action - Execute Command
components.description: The action Execute Command executes a shell command and stores the output in variables.

components.name: Execute Flows
components.title: Action - Execute Flows
components.description: The action Execute Flows executes one or multiple flows specified in the field Flow pattern list.

components.name: Execute Root Command
components.title: Action - Execute Root Command
components.description: The action Execute Root Command executes a shell command as root by passing the command to su and stores the output in variables.

components.name: Execute SSH Command (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Execute SSH Command (Experimental)
components.description: The action Execute SSH Command connects to an SSH server and executes a command.

components.name: Exit Device Idle/Doze Mode
components.title: Action - Exit Device Idle/Doze Mode
components.description: The action Exit Device Idle/Doze Mode exits the device idle/doze mode.

components.name: Export Flows
components.title: Action - Export Flows
components.description: The action Export Flows exports the selected flows to the specified file.

components.name: Flashlight
components.title: Action - Flashlight
components.description: The action Flashlight enables or disables the flashlight of the device.

components.name: FTP Create Directories
components.title: Action - FTP Create Directories
components.description: The action FTP Create Directories creates one or multiple directories on an FTP server.

components.name: FTP Delete Files
components.title: Action - FTP Delete Files
components.description: The action FTP Delete Files deletes the files specified on the FTP server.

components.name: FTP Download Files
components.title: Action - FTP Download Files
components.description: The action FTP Download Files downloads files and folders stored on an FTP server.

components.name: FTP Init Variable File List
components.title: Action - FTP Init Variable File List
components.description: The action FTP Init Variable File List lists the files of a directory that match the specified name pattern.

components.name: FTP Upload File
components.title: Action - FTP Upload File
components.description: The action FTP Upload File uploads one file to an FTP server.

components.name: FTP Upload Files
components.title: Action - FTP Upload Files
components.description: The action FTP Upload Files uploads files and folders to an FTP server.

components.name: Gleeo Create Entry
components.title: Action - Gleeo Create Entry
components.description: The action Gleeo Create Entry creates an entry of the specified project and task in Gleeo Time Tracker.

components.name: Gleeo Filesystem Export
components.title: Action - Gleeo Filesystem Export
components.description: The action Gleeo Filesystem Export creates a CSV export of the defined projects and time range.

components.name: Gleeo Start Recording
components.title: Action - Gleeo Start Recording
components.description: The action Gleeo Start Recording starts recording the defined project and task in Gleeo Time Tracker when this task is not already recording.

components.name: Gleeo Stop Recording
components.title: Action - Gleeo Stop Recording
components.description: The action Gleeo Stop Recording stops recording the currently recording task in Gleeo Time Tracker.

components.name: Google Drive Create Directories (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Google Drive Create Directories (Experimental)
components.description: The action Google Drive Create Directories (Experimental) creates one or multiple directories on Google Drive.

components.name: Google Drive Delete Files (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Google Drive Delete Files (Experimental)
components.description: The action Google Drive Delete Files (Experimental) deletes the defined files on Dropbox.

components.name: Google Drive Download Files (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Google Drive Download Files (Experimental)
components.description: The action Google Drive Download Files (Experimental) downloads multiple files and directories recursively to your device.

components.name: Google Drive Init Variable File List
components.title: Action - Google Drive Init Variable File List
components.description: The action Google Drive Init Variable File List lists the files of a directory that match the specified name pattern.

components.name: Google Drive Upload Files (Experimental)
