components.description: The action Google Drive Upload Files (Experimental) uploads one or multiple files and directories recursively to your Google Drive.

components.name: Hide Custom Widget Overlay
components.title: Action - Hide Custom Widget Overlay
components.description: The action Hide Custom Widget Overlay hides a previously shown overlay.

components.name: Hide Custom Widget Overlay (Android Wear)
components.title: Action - Hide Custom Widget Overlay (Android Wear)
components.description: The action Hide Custom Widget Overlay (Android Wear) hides a previously shown overlay.

components.name: HTTP Request
components.title: Action - HTTP Request
components.description: The action HTTP Request requests a resource from a server using the specified HTTP request method.

components.name: Import Flows
components.title: Action - Import Flows
components.description: The action Import Flows imports all flows of the specified file. The imported flows are disabled. Already existing flows are not imported. Flows can be enabled after importing when desired using action Set Flow State and the variable {importedflownames,listformat,comma}.

components.name: Init Variable Contact List
components.title: Action - Init Variable Contact List
components.description: The action Init Variable Contact List stores the list of contacts in the specified variable.

components.name: Init Variable File List
components.title: Action - Init Variable File List
components.description: The action Init Variable File List lists all files or only the newly added files in a directory and stores the list in a variable.

components.name: Init Variable Image File
components.title: Action - Init Variable Image File
components.description: The action Init Variable Image File loads the pixel data of an image into the specified local variable to modify the image with action Modify Image or to read color values of pixels with script function getPixelColor.

components.name: Init Variable Image Metadata
components.title: Action - Init Variable Image Metadata
components.description: The action Init Variable Image Metadata extracts the metadata (e.g. Exif tags) from an image and stores the values in a map (key=label/name of the tag, value=description or raw value of the tag).

components.name: Init Variable Location
components.title: Action - Init Variable Location
components.description: The action Init Variable Location acquires one location from the defined provider and stores the location in the variable.

components.name: Init Variable Next Alarm
components.title: Action - Init Variable Next Alarm
components.description: The action Init Variable Next Alarm fills the time of the next currently known alarm into the specified variable.

components.name: Init Variable Notifications on Statusbar
components.title: Action - Init Variable Notifications on Statusbar
components.description: The action Init Variable Notifications on Statusbar stores all currently shown notifications as a list in a variable.

components.name: Init Variable Package Info
components.title: Action - Init Variable Package Info
components.description: The action Init Variable Package Info loads information of the specified apps/packages and stores the information in a map.

components.name: Init Variable Random Number
components.title: Action - Init Variable Random Number
components.description: The action Init Variable Random Number generates a random number in a defined interval.

components.name: Init Variable System Setting
components.title: Action - Init Variable System Setting
components.description: The action Init Variable System Setting reads a value from the system setting database and stores the value in a variable.

components.name: Init Variable System Setting (Android Wear)
components.title: Action - Init Variable System Setting (Android Wear)
components.description: The action Init Variable System Setting (Android Wear) reads a value from the system setting database and stores the value in a variable.

components.name: Init Variable Text File
components.title: Action - Init Variable Text File
components.description: The action Init Variable Text File reads the contents of a text file into the specified variable. Files up to 1MB are supported. Binary files are not supported.

components.name: Init Variable WiFi Access Point List
components.title: Action - Init Variable WiFi Access Point List
components.description: The action Init Variable WiFi Access Point List lists all configured or only enabled/disabled wifi networks into a variable.

components.name: Init Variables Bluetooth Device List
components.title: Action - Init Variables Bluetooth Device List
components.description: The action Init Variables Bluetooth Device List lists all paired, connected or not connected bluetooth devices in a variable.

components.name: Init Variables Call Log
components.title: Action - Init Variables Call Log
components.description: The action Init Variables Call Log initializes variables with the values of the last entry of the call log.

components.name: Init Variables Contact Info
components.title: Action - Init Variables Contact Info
components.description: The action Init Variables Contact Info loads information of the specified contact and stores the information in a map.

components.name: Init Variables Device Orientation
components.title: Action - Init Variables Device Orientation
components.description: The action Init Variables Device Orientation measures the device orientation using the accelerometer and magnetometer sensors of the device.

components.name: Init Variables File Info
components.title: Action - Init Variables File Info
components.description: The action Init Variables File Info provides information about a file as variables to the flow.

components.name: Init Variables Gleeo Project Structure
components.title: Action - Init Variables Gleeo Project Structure
components.description: The action Init Variables Gleeo Project Structure initializes a variable with the domains, projects or tasks from Gleeo Time Tracker.

components.name: Init Variables Gleeo Recording
components.title: Action - Init Variables Gleeo Recording
components.description: The action Init Variables Gleeo Recording checks if a task is recording in Gleeo Time Tracker and stores the recording project and task in variables.

components.name: Init Variables Media Metadata
components.title: Action - Init Variables Media Metadata
components.description: The action Init Variables Media Metadata loads the metadata of a media file into local variables (see variables section below).

components.name: Init Variables Media Session (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Init Variables Media Session (Experimental)
components.description: The action Init Variables Media Session (Experimental) fills the information of the media session of the specified media player into variables.

components.name: Init Variables Network Statistics
components.title: Action - Init Variables Network Statistics
components.description: The action Init Variables Network Statistics queries the transferred amount of data of the specified network interfaces. The network statistics are recorded by the operating system itself and is stored in blocks of two hours (device dependent). Queries that don't fall on such a two hour limit, will be interpolated (device dependent) so results might not be accurate especially for short time intervals. The data of the network statistics is stored for each UID (user identification) of the executed process. Many apps/packages of the system are aggregated under UID 1000 and can not be differentiated further. The package selection shows the UID in brackets. Data not available to the network statistics of the device can not be considered by this action (e.g. when a device is factory reset).

components.name: Init Variables Network Traffic
components.title: Action - Init Variables Network Traffic
components.description: The action Init Variables Network Traffic initializes variables with the transmitted and received bytes since device boot of the system or a specific user ID that runs a given app.

components.name: Init Variables Phone Info
components.title: Action - Init Variables Phone Info
components.description: The action Init Variables Phone Info initializes the desired variables (not all values are available on all devices).

components.name: Input Dialog
components.title: Action - Input Dialog
components.description: The action Input Dialog shows an input dialog with an input text field, password field, single- or multi-selection list.

components.name: Input Speech (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Input Speech (Experimental)
components.description: The action Input Speech (Experimental) starts the speech recognition of the device and provides the recognized text to the flow in variable value. The speech recognition engine usually requires network access.

components.name: Input Speech (Android Wear)
components.title: Action - Input Speech (Android Wear)
components.description: The action Input Speech (Android Wear) starts the speech recognition of the device and provides the recognized text to the flow in variable value. The speech recognition engine usually requires network access.

components.name: Kill App
components.title: Action - Kill App
components.description: The action Kill App kills the processes of an app running in the background.

components.name: Kill App Process
components.title: Action - Kill App Process
components.description: The action Kill App Process sends the defined signal to the process using the kill command.

components.name: Launch App
components.title: Action - Launch App
components.description: The action Launch App starts an app or a specific activity of an app.

components.name: Launch Shortcut
components.title: Action - Launch Shortcut
components.description: The action Launch Shortcut starts a previously defined shortcut.

components.name: Lock Device
components.title: Action - Lock Device
components.description: The action Lock Device immediately locks the device.

components.name: Mail with Gmail
components.title: Action - Mail with Gmail
components.description: The action Mail with Gmail sends a mail using your Gmail account.

components.name: Map Values
components.title: Action - Map Values
components.description: The action Map Values takes an input value (the key) and maps it to an output value.

components.name: Message Dialog
components.title: Action - Message Dialog
components.description: The action Message Dialog shows a dialog with a message and an optional title.

components.name: Modify Automagic Notification on Statusbar
components.title: Action - Modify Automagic Notification on Statusbar
components.description: The action Modify Automagic Notification on Statusbar modifies the permanent notification usually shown by Automagic for technical reasons. The appearance of a modified notification is reset to the default when one of the settings in Automagic pertaining to the notification is changed.

components.name: Modify Call Log
components.title: Action - Modify Call Log
components.description: The action Modify Call Log marks the entries of the call log as acknowledged or clears the call log.

components.name: Modify Image
components.title: Action - Modify Image
components.description: The action Modify Image can be used to modify an image that was previously loaded with an action Init Variable Image File.

components.name: Modify Notification Channel
components.title: Action - Modify Notification Channel
components.description: The action Modify Notification Channel modifies a notification channel.

components.name: Move Files
components.title: Action - Move Files
components.description: The action Move Files locally moves one or a list of files to the specified target directory or file. A move is implemented to use a rename operation when possible. If a rename is not possible, the file/folder is copied to the target directory and afterwards the source is deleted.

components.name: Notification on Screen
components.title: Action - Notification on Screen
components.description: The action Notification on Screen shows a notification on the screen for a short period of time.

components.name: Notification on Screen (Android Wear)
components.title: Action - Notification on Screen (Android Wear)
components.description: The action Notification on Screen (Android Wear) shows a notification on the screen for a short period of time.

components.name: Notification on Statusbar
components.title: Action - Notification on Statusbar
components.description: The action Notification on Statusbar shows a notification on the status bar. The notification is displayed until the notification is clicked or clear is pressed.

components.name: Open URL in Browser
components.title: Action - Open URL in Browser
components.description: The action Open URL in Browser opens the browser with the specified URL.

components.name: Perform Action on Notification on Statusbar
components.title: Action - Perform Action on Notification on Statusbar
components.description: The action Perform Action on Notification on Statusbar clicks the notification or one of the action buttons which are usually available in the big, expanded notification on Android 4.1+. The flow must be executed by a trigger Notification on Statusbar Displayed or the action after a condition Notification on Statusbar Displayed otherwise Automagic has no possibility to access the notification.

components.name: Plugin (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Plugin (Experimental)
components.description: The action Plugin (Experimental) executes the action defined in a plugin. Most plugins don't offer a way to let Automagic wait for the plugin to finish. You can use an action Sleep to wait a short amount of time.

components.name: Post Tweet
components.title: Action - Post Tweet
components.description: The action Post Tweet posts a regular Twitter message.

components.name: Post Twitter Direct Message
components.title: Action - Post Twitter Direct Message
components.description: The action Post Twitter Direct Message posts a Twitter direct message to one recipient.

components.name: Query Content Provider
components.title: Action - Query Content Provider
components.description: The action Query Content Provider allows to load data from a content provider of another app. A content provider presents data to Automagic as one or more tables that are similar to the tables found in a relational database.

components.name: Reboot
components.title: Action - Reboot
components.description: The action Reboot restarts the device.

components.name: Remove Notification Missed Calls
components.title: Action - Remove Notification Missed Calls
components.description: The action Remove Notification Missed Calls removes the missed calls notification in the statusbar.

components.name: Remove Notification on Statusbar
components.title: Action - Remove Notification on Statusbar
components.description: The action Remove Notification on Statusbar removes the specified or all notifications on the statusbar added by the action Notification on Statusbar.

components.name: Remove WiFi Access Point
components.title: Action - Remove WiFi Access Point
components.description: The action Remove WiFi Access Point removes a WiFi configuration.

components.name: Request Sync
components.title: Action - Request Sync
components.description: The action Request Sync starts the synchronisation process of one or multiple accounts or some parts of the accounts. The order and the exact timing of the synchronisation is controlled by Android. The action does not wait for the synchronisation to finish.

components.name: Reregister Media Button Receiver
components.title: Action - Reregister Media Button Receiver
components.description: The action Reregister Media Button Receiver registers Automagic as a receiver of media button events again. This is useful in conjunction with trigger Media Button Receiver when another app requested to receive the media button events and Automagic thus does not receive the events anymore.

components.name: Restore Audio Volumes
components.title: Action - Restore Audio Volumes
components.description: The action Restore Audio Volumes restores the audio volumes previously stored in global variables by action Store Audio Volumes.

components.name: Save Variable in Image File
components.title: Action - Save Variable in Image File
components.description: The action Save Variable in Image File saves the pixel data that was previously loaded with an action Init Variable Image File into a file.

components.name: Save Widget to Image File
components.title: Action - Save Widget to Image File
components.description: The action Save Widget to Image File saves the current image of a widget to a file.

components.name: Scan Barcode
components.title: Action - Scan Barcode
components.description: The action Scan Barcode opens an activity to scan a barcode using the camera of the device.

components.name: Script
components.title: Action - Script
components.description: The action Script executes a script doing some simple calculations and can be used to modify variables.

components.name: Seek Action Sound
components.title: Action - Seek Action Sound
components.description: The action Seek Action Sound seeks in the currently executing action Sound.

components.name: Send Broadcast
components.title: Action - Send Broadcast
components.description: The action Send Broadcast send a broadcast using the specified intent. Please also see the documentation of the Android Intent class.

components.name: Send SMS
components.title: Action - Send SMS
components.description: The action Send SMS sends an SMS to the specified phone number.

components.name: Send USSD Request
components.title: Action - Send USSD Request
components.description: The action Send USSD Request sends a USSD request to the provider.

components.name: Send Wake on LAN Packet
components.title: Action - Send Wake on LAN Packet
components.description: The action Send Wake on LAN Packet sends a Wake on LAN packet using UDP to the specified IP address and port.

components.name: Set Airplane Mode
components.title: Action - Set Airplane Mode
components.description: The action Set Airplane Mode sets the airplane mode of the phone on or off.

components.name: Set Alarm
components.title: Action - Set Alarm
components.description: The action Set Alarm creates an alarm in the alarm app available on the device.

components.name: Set App Notification Peekable
components.title: Action - Set App Notification Peekable
components.description: The action Set App Notification Peekable changes the setting whether app notifications of an app can be emphasized by sliding briefly into view.

components.name: Set App Notification Priority
components.title: Action - Set App Notification Priority
components.description: The action Set App Notification Priority changes the setting whether app notifications are important or not for a particular app.

components.name: Set App Notification State
components.title: Action - Set App Notification State
components.description: The action Set App Notification State enables or disables the capability of an app to post notifications.

components.name: Set Audio Manager Mode
components.title: Action - Set Audio Manager Mode
components.description: The action Set Audio Manager Mode changes the mode of the audio manager to either Normal, Ringtone or In call. The audio mode encompasses audio routing AND the behavior of the telephony layer.

components.name: Set Audio Stream Volume
components.title: Action - Set Audio Stream Volume
components.description: The action Set Audio Stream Volume changes the volume of a audio stream of a specific type.

components.name: Set Accelerometer Rotation
components.title: Action - Set Accelerometer Rotation
components.description: The action Set Accelerometer Rotation turns on or off the Auto-rotate screen setting.

components.name: Set Auto Sync State
components.title: Action - Set Auto Sync State
components.description: The action Set Auto Sync State turns the automatic synchronisation on or off.

components.name: Set Bluetooth SCO State
components.title: Action - Set Bluetooth SCO State
components.description: The action Set Bluetooth SCO State turns Bluetooth SCO for communications on or off.

components.name: Set Bluetooth State
components.title: Action - Set Bluetooth State
components.description: The action Set Bluetooth State turns Bluetooth globally on or off.

components.name: Set Bluetooth Tethering State
components.title: Action - Set Bluetooth Tethering State
components.description: The action Set Bluetooth Tethering State turns Bluetooth tethering setting on or off.

components.name: Set Camera Usage State
components.title: Action - Set Camera Usage State
components.description: The action Set Camera Usage State allows or denies the camera usage for apps.

components.name: Set Car UI Mode
components.title: Action - Set Car UI Mode
components.description: The action Set Car UI Mode puts the device into car UI mode.

components.name: Set Cyanogen/LineageOS Profile
components.title: Action - Set Cyanogen/LineageOS Profile
components.description: The action Set Cyanogen/LineageOS Profile changes the currently set Cyanogen/LineageOS profile.

components.name: Set Data Roaming State
components.title: Action - Set Data Roaming State
components.description: The action Set Data Roaming State turns the global data roaming setting on or off.

components.name: Set Default Input Method
components.title: Action - Set Default Input Method
components.description: The action Set Default Input Method changes the current input method/keyboard.

components.name: Set Ringtone
components.title: Action - Set Ringtone
components.description: The action Set Ringtone sets the default ringtone of the specified type (ringtone, alarm or notification).

components.name: Set Disabled Keyguard Features
components.title: Action - Set Disabled Keyguard Features
components.description: The action Set Disabled Keyguard Features asks the system to disable the specified list of features on the lock screen (usually only affects secure lock screens like PIN, password lock screen).

components.name: Set Flow State
components.title: Action - Set Flow State
components.description: The action Set Flow State enables or disables one or many flows.

components.name: Set GPS State
components.title: Action - Set GPS State
components.description: The action Set GPS State turns GPS globally on or off.

components.name: Set Immersive Mode
components.title: Action - Set Immersive Mode
components.description: The action Set Immersive Mode forces immersive/fullscreen mode.

components.name: Set Interruptions Mode
components.title: Action - Set Interruptions Mode
components.description: The action Set Interruptions Mode changes the mode whether alarms and notifications are allowed to interrupt you.

components.name: Set Keyguard State
components.title: Action - Set Keyguard State
components.description: The action Set Keyguard State globally disables or reenables the keyguard after it was disabled by this action.

components.name: Set LineageOS System Setting
components.title: Action - Set LineageOS System Setting
components.description: The action Set LineageOS System Setting stores the specified value in the settings database of the system.

components.name: Set Live Wallpaper
components.title: Action - Set Live Wallpaper
components.description: The action Set Live Wallpaper changes the wallpaper of the phone to the defined live wallpaper.

components.name: Set Lock PIN/Password
components.title: Action - Set Lock PIN/Password
components.description: The action Set Lock PIN/Password sets the PIN/Password of the screen lock or resets the screen lock.

components.name: Set Lock Pattern State
components.title: Action - Set Lock Pattern State
components.description: The action Set Lock Pattern State enables or disables the system setting whether the lock pattern should be used as the screen lock.

components.name: Set Microphone Mute
components.title: Action - Set Microphone Mute
components.description: The action Set Microphone Mute mutes or unmutes the microphone of the phone.

components.name: Set Mobile Datanetwork State
components.title: Action - Set Mobile Datanetwork State
components.description: The action Set Mobile Datanetwork State turns the mobile datanetwork on or off.

components.name: Set Mobile Network Mode (2G/3G)
components.title: Action - Set Mobile Network Mode (2G/3G)
components.description: The action Set Mobile Network Mode (2G/3G) changes the network mode of the phone.

components.name: Set Network Location State
components.title: Action - Set Network Location State
components.description: The action Set Network Location State changes the setting whether the system can use WiFi access points and the mobile network to determine your location.

components.name: Set NFC State
components.title: Action - Set NFC State
components.description: The action Set NFC State turns NFC globally on or off.

components.name: Set Night Mode
components.title: Action - Set Night Mode
components.description: The action Set Night Mode turns the night mode of the device on or off or activates the automatic switch based on time and location. Changes to the night mode are only effective when the car or desk mode is enabled on a device. Note: Not supported by all devices.

components.name: Set Battery Saver Mode
components.title: Action - Set Battery Saver Mode
components.description: The action Set Battery Saver Mode turns on the battery saver mode of the device (Android 5+). Battery saver mode can not be enabled when the device is charging.

components.name: Set Proximity Screen Off State
components.title: Action - Set Proximity Screen Off State
components.description: The action Set Proximity Screen Off State turns on the function of Android that turns the display off, when the proximity sensor detects an object.

components.name: Set Restrict Background Data State
components.title: Action - Set Restrict Background Data State
components.description: The action Set Restrict Background Data State

components.name: Set Ringer Mode
components.title: Action - Set Ringer Mode
components.description: The action Set Ringer Mode changes the ringer to either Normal, Silent or Vibrate mode.

components.name: Set Screen Brightness
components.title: Action - Set Screen Brightness
components.description: The action Set Screen Brightness changes the screen brightness.

components.name: Set Screen Orientation
components.title: Action - Set Screen Orientation
components.description: The action Set Screen Orientation forces the device to use the specified screen orientation setting. It can be used to force the screen to always use landscape mode or to use the sensor to enable reverse portrait and reverse landscape orientations.

components.name: Set Screen Timeout
components.title: Action - Set Screen Timeout
components.description: The action Set Screen Timeout changes the screen timeout.

components.name: Set Speakerphone State
components.title: Action - Set Speakerphone State
components.description: The action Set Speakerphone State turns the speakerphone of the phone on or off. On most devices a call must be active for this action to have any effect.

components.name: Set System Locale
components.title: Action - Set System Locale
components.description: The action Set System Locale changes the currently use system locale.

components.name: Set System Setting
components.title: Action - Set System Setting
components.description: The action Set System Setting stores the specified value in the settings database of the system.

components.name: Set System Setting (Android Wear)
components.title: Action - Set System Setting (Android Wear)
components.description: The action Set System Setting (Android Wear) stores the specified value in the settings database of the system.

components.name: Set Telephony Radio State
components.title: Action - Set Telephony Radio State
components.description: The action Set Telephony Radio State turns the radio of the phone on or off.

components.name: Set Timer
components.title: Action - Set Timer
components.description: The action Set Timer creates a timer in a compatible timer app installed on the device.

components.name: Set USB Debugging State
components.title: Action - Set USB Debugging State
components.description: The action Set USB Debugging State enables or disables the USB debugging setting.

components.name: Set USB Tethering State
components.title: Action - Set USB Tethering State
components.description: The action Set USB Tethering State turns USB tethering on or off.

components.name: Set Vibrate on Ring State
components.title: Action - Set Vibrate on Ring State
components.description: The action Set Vibrate on Ring State changes the setting whether the device should vibrate on ring or not.

components.name: Set Wallpaper
components.title: Action - Set Wallpaper
components.description: The action Set Wallpaper changes the wallpaper of the phone to the defined static image.

components.name: Set WiFi Access Point Priority
components.title: Action - Set WiFi Access Point Priority
components.description: The action Set WiFi Access Point Priority sets the priority of an access point configuration to control which access point is chosen to connect to by the phone.

components.name: Set WiFi Sleep Policy
components.title: Action - Set WiFi Sleep Policy
components.description: The action Set WiFi Sleep Policy changes the currently active sleep policy.

components.name: Set WiFi State
components.title: Action - Set WiFi State
components.description: The action Set WiFi State turns WiFi globally on or off.

components.name: Set WiFi State (Android Wear)
components.title: Action - Set WiFi State (Android Wear)
components.description: The action Set WiFi State (Android Wear) turns WiFi globally on or off.

components.name: Set Wifi Tethering State
components.title: Action - Set Wifi Tethering State
components.description: The action Set Wifi Tethering State turns WiFi tethering on or off.

components.name: Show Call Log
components.title: Action - Show Call Log
components.description: The action Show Call Log opens the built-in App to show the call log.

components.name: Show Control UI Gesture Recorder
components.title: Action - Show Control UI Gesture Recorder
components.description: The action Show Control UI Gesture Recorder shows the dialog for recording gestures to simulate user interactions (like action Control UI->Show overlay control->Gesture)

components.name: Show Control UI Infos
components.title: Action - Show Control UI Infos
components.description: The action Show Control UI Infos shows the dialog for recording clicks to simulate user interactions (like action Control UI->Show overlay control->Info)

components.name: Show Custom Widget Overlay
components.title: Action - Show Custom Widget Overlay
components.description: The action Show Custom Widget Overlay displays a custom Widget (defined within Automagic) on an arbitrary position on the display. The overlay is also shown on the lock screen on many Android versions.

components.name: Show Custom Widget Overlay (Android Wear)
components.title: Action - Show Custom Widget Overlay (Android Wear)
components.description: The action Show Custom Widget Overlay (Android Wear) displays a custom Widget (defined within Automagic) on an arbitrary position on the display.

components.name: Show Home Screen
components.title: Action - Show Home Screen
components.description: The action Show Home Screen launches the home screen.

components.name: Show Input Method Selector
components.title: Action - Show Input Method Selector
components.description: The action Show Input Method Selector shows the screen to select the input method/keyboard.

components.name: Shutdown
components.title: Action - Shutdown
components.description: The action Shutdown shuts the device down.

components.name: Silence Ringer
components.title: Action - Silence Ringer
components.description: The action Silence Ringer silences the ringer and stops the vibrator when an incoming call is currently ringing.

components.name: Sleep
components.title: Action - Sleep
components.description: The action Sleep pauses the flow execution for a certain amount of time.

components.name: Snooze Notification on Statusbar
components.title: Action - Snooze Notification on Statusbar
components.description: The action Snooze Notification on Statusbar asks the system to hide a notification for a defined amount of time. The flow must be executed by a trigger Notification on Statusbar Displayed or the action after a condition Notification on Statusbar Displayed otherwise Automagic has no possibility to access the notification.

components.name: Sound
components.title: Action - Sound
components.description: The action Sound plays the selected sound.

components.name: Speech Output
components.title: Action - Speech Output
components.description: The action Speech Output uses the default text to speech engine installed to read the defined text.

components.name: Start Activity
components.title: Action - Start Activity
components.description: The action Start Activity starts an activity using the specified intent. Please also see the documentation of the Android Intent class.

components.name: Start Daydream
components.title: Action - Start Daydream
components.description: The action Start Daydream starts the daydream configured in the Android settings.

components.name: Start Recording Audio
components.title: Action - Start Recording Audio
components.description: The action Start Recording Audio starts recording the specified audio source to the defined file. Only one audio file can be captured at a time. The recording can be stopped manually using the shown statusbar notification or by executing the action Stop Recording Audio.

components.name: Start Recording Screen (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Start Recording Screen (Experimental)
components.description: The action Start Recording Screen (Experimental) starts to record the screen as a video to the defined file. Only one recording session can be active at the same time. The recording can be stopped manually using the shown statusbar notification or by executing the action Stop Recording Screen.

components.name: Start Service
components.title: Action - Start Service
components.description: The action Start Service starts a service using the specified intent. Please also see the documentation of the Android Intent class.

components.name: Stop Action Sound
components.title: Action - Stop Action Sound
components.description: The action Stop Action Sound stops a currently executing action Sound

components.name: Stop Action Speech Output
components.title: Action - Stop Action Speech Output
components.description: The action Stop Action Speech Output stops a currently executing action Speech Output

components.name: Stop Flows
components.title: Action - Stop Flows
components.description: The action Stop Flows stops one or multiple flows specified in the field Flow pattern list as soon as possible. Use an action Set Flow State to disable flows.

components.name: Stop Recording Audio
components.title: Action - Stop Recording Audio
components.description: The action Stop Recording Audio stops the currently recording audio started with action Start Recording Audio.

components.name: Stop Recording Screen (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Stop Recording Screen (Experimental)
components.description: The action Stop Recording Screen (Experimental) stops a recording that was previously started with action Start Recording Screen.

components.name: Store Audio Volumes
components.title: Action - Store Audio Volumes
components.description: The action Store Audio Volumes stores the currently set audio volumes in global variables to restore using action Restore Audio Volumes.

components.name: Take Picture
components.title: Action - Take Picture
components.description: The action Take Picture takes a picture using the built-in camera app or directly in the background without showing a user interface/preview (Android 4+)

components.name: Take Screenshot (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Take Screenshot (Experimental)
components.description: The action Take Screenshot (Experimental) creates a screenshot of the currently displayed screen.

components.name: Turn Screen On
components.title: Action - Turn Screen On
components.description: The action Turn Screen On turns the screen on for a few seconds.

components.name: Turn Screen On (Android Wear)
components.title: Action - Turn Screen On (Android Wear)
components.description: The action Turn Screen On (Android Wear) turns the screen on for a few seconds.

components.name: Unzip Files
components.title: Action - Unzip Files
components.description: The action Unzip Files unzips all files and folders contained in the ZIP file to the specified target folder.

components.name: Update Media Database (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Update Media Database (Experimental)
components.description: The action Update Media Database (Experimental) checks the specified file or folder to delete not existing files from the media database and scans all existing files so the system can add them to the media database when desired.

components.name: Update Quick Settings Tile
components.title: Action - Update Quick Settings Tile
components.description: The action Update Quick Settings Tile updates a tile that was create with trigger Quick Settings Tile Selected.

components.name: Vibrate
components.title: Action - Vibrate
components.description: The action Vibrate vibrates with a specific pattern.

components.name: Vibrate (Android Wear)
components.title: Action - Vibrate (Android Wear)
components.description: The action Vibrate (Android Wear) vibrates with a specific pattern.

components.name: Voice Search (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Voice Search (Experimental)
components.description: The action Voice Search (Experimental) starts the built-in voice search of the system. The speech recognition engine usually requires network access.

components.name: WiFi Reassociate
components.title: Action - WiFi Reassociate
components.description: The action WiFi Reassociate reconnects to the currently active access point.

components.name: WiFi Scan
components.title: Action - WiFi Scan
components.description: The action WiFi Scan starts a scan for available access points.

components.name: Write HTTP Response File (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Write HTTP Response File (Experimental)
components.description: The action Write HTTP Response File (Experimental) writes the specified file as a response to a HTTP request. The flow must be invoked by a trigger HTTP Request to write a response.

components.name: Write HTTP Response Text (Experimental)
components.title: Action - Write HTTP Response Text (Experimental)
components.description: The action Write HTTP Response Text (Experimental) writes the specified text as a response to a HTTP request. The flow must be invoked by a trigger HTTP Request to write a response.

components.name: Write to File
components.title: Action - Write to File
components.description: The action Write to File writes the defined text to the specified file. The action automatically creates the file when the file does not exist yet.

components.name: Write to Log
components.title: Action - Write to Log
components.description: The action Write to Log appends the defined text to the log file.

components.name: Zip Files
components.title: Action - Zip Files
components.description: The action Zip Files creates a Zip archive containing the specified files and directories.
